name: aps-v2
description: ระบบช่วยวางแผนการเรียน APS-v2 — CS2565

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:integration: npm run db:migrate:test && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:auth: npm run db:migrate:test && node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/prepare-browser-tests.ts && playwright test --config playwright.auth.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:simulation: npm run db:migrate:test && node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/verification/round-6/prepare-browser.ts && playwright test --config playwright.simulation.config.ts && node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/verification/round-6/check-browser.ts
scripts.test:e2e:admin-history: npm run db:migrate:test && node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/verification/admin-history/prepare-browser.ts && playwright test --config playwright.admin-history.config.ts && node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/verification/admin-history/check-browser.ts
scripts.test:e2e:admin: npm run db:migrate:test && node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/verification/round-7/prepare-browser.ts && playwright test --config playwright.admin-audit.config.ts && node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/verification/round-7/check-browser.ts
scripts.test:e2e:plans: npm run db:migrate:test && node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/verification/round-5/prepare-browser.ts && playwright test --config playwright.plans.config.ts && node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/verification/round-5/check-browser.ts
